summary: Valuation approach that estimates value from land value plus depreciated improvement cost; commonly relevant to newer improvements, special-use property, or where market/income evidence is limited.
plain_language: Estimate the land, estimate what the building would cost, subtract depreciation, then reconcile with market evidence.

relationships.note: One of the major appraisal approaches.
Improvement cost is adjusted for depreciation.
Land component often comes from land schedules/tables.

source_refs.citation: Nebraska DOR PAD, Court Case Summaries History.
IAAO, Standard on Mass Appraisal of Real Property.
